args.content_summary: On March 14, 2025, Dana Kessler (VP Operations) directed Ruth Okafor (Site Manager, Complex 4) in TLG-EM-0414 to take dehumidification units DH-4A through DH-4D at Silo Complex 4 offline on a load-shed schedule, instructing it be logged as routine maintenance despite the WCSA humidity clause; Okafor confirmed execution in TLG-EM-0419 the next morning (de-energized 11:10 PM, March 14).
